```{r}
# Load tidyverse (if not already loaded)
library(tidyverse)

# Sample coral data
coral_monitoring <- tibble(
  site = c("Site_A", "Site_B", "Site_C"),
  depth_m = c(12, 35, 8)
)

# Classify depth using if_else
coral_monitoring <- coral_monitoring %>% 
  mutate(zone = if_else(depth_m > 30, "Deep Reef", "Shallow Reef"))
```

```{r}
coral_monitoring <- coral_monitoring %>% 
  mutate(reef_category = case_when(
    depth_m < 10  ~ "Lagoon / Flats",
    depth_m <= 30 ~ "Crest / Slope",
    depth_m > 30  ~ "Mesophotic / Deep",
    TRUE          ~ "Unclassified" # Catch-all remainder
  ))
```

```{r}
# Function Definition
calculate_coral_mortality <- function(initial_count, surviving_count) {
  
  # Logic safety switch using our conditional tools!
  if (initial_count <= 0) {
    stop("Initial count must be greater than zero.")
  }
  
  mortality_rate <- (initial_count - surviving_count) / initial_count
  return(mortality_rate)
}

# Utilizing your custom function
calculate_coral_mortality(initial_count = 120, surviving_count = 84)
```
```{r}
convert_temp_c_to_f <- function(celsius) {
  if (celsius < -273.15) {
    stop("Temperature cannot be below absolute zero (-273.15°C).")
  }
  
  fahrenheit <- (celsius * 9/5) + 32
  return(fahrenheit)
}

# Valid test
convert_temp_c_to_f(25)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)

# Load the penguins dataset
data(penguins)

# Create custom color palettes
species_colors <- c(
  "Adelie" = "#FF6B6B",
  "Chinstrap" = "#4ECDC4",
  "Gentoo" = "#45B7D1"
)

# Generate boxplot comparing flipper_length_mm across species, faceted by island
penguins %>%
  drop_na(flipper_length_mm) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = species, y = flipper_length_mm, fill = species)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8, outlier.size = 2, outlier.alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~island, ncol = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = species_colors) +
  labs(
    title = "Flipper Length Distribution by Species and Island",
    subtitle = "Palmer Penguins Dataset",
    x = "Species",
    y = "Flipper Length (mm)",
    fill = "Species"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray60"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray90"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

# Optional: Save the plot
ggsave("flipper_length_boxplot.png", width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 300)

```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)

# Load the penguins dataset
data(penguins)

# Create custom color palettes
species_colors <- c(
  "Adelie" = "#FF6B6B",
  "Chinstrap" = "#4ECDC4",
  "Gentoo" = "#45B7D1"
)

# Generate scatter plot with linear regression trend lines
penguins %>%
  drop_na(body_mass_g, flipper_length_mm) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = flipper_length_mm, y = body_mass_g, color = species, fill = species)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.6, shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, alpha = 0.15, size = 1.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = species_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = species_colors) +
  labs(
    title = "Body Mass vs Flipper Length by Species",
    subtitle = "Palmer Penguins Dataset with Linear Regression Trends",
    x = "Flipper Length (mm)",
    y = "Body Mass (g)",
    color = "Species",
    fill = "Species"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray60"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

# Optional: Save the plot
ggsave("flipper_mass_regression.png", width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)

```
